Miqat Qarn Al Manazil (Al Sail Al Kabir Miqat)

miqat.note: Pilgrims on the Taif - al-Hada road enter ihram at the Wadi Mahram point of the same miqat (miqat_qarn_al_manazil_wadi_mahram).

miqat.point: Miqat mosque of Wadi Mahram (al-Hada road)

sources.ref: Wadi Mahram faces the As-Sayl miqat and serves the al-Hada road

miqat.note: Second ihram point of Qarn al-Manazil, 33.5 km from the As-Sayl al-Kabir point: without it a pilgrim on the al-Hada road never comes within the alert radius.

sources.ref: pilgrims enter ihram at the new As-Sa'diyah mosque, 21 km from the old miqat

miqat.note: The old As-Sa'diyah miqat (Google Maps 20.70722, 39.91028) is 21.5 km north on the same road; the alert uses the current mosque, reached first from the south.
Historic site of the Iraqi Hajj road, now known as ad-Dariba (Saudipedia article 15170); most pilgrims from that direction pass Qarn al-Manazil today.

miqat_alert: F18: alert when the user (travelling towards Makkah) comes within the configured radius of a miqat point. Each point is the miqat's ihram mosque, verified 2026-09-30: two independent map sources (OpenStreetMap and Google Maps) agree within 110 m and the stored point is their midpoint (4 decimals, about 10 m); see each entry's sources. Qarn al-Manazil has two points: As-Sayl al-Kabir and Wadi Mahram (Taif - al-Hada road).
